request.style: English, roots reggae, one drop drums, heavy bass, offbeat guitar skank, Hammond organ bubble, horns, a deep male lead with female harmonies, uplifting, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Spirit of the Lord is upon me
Because the Lord has anointed me
To bring good news to the poor
To bind up the brokenhearted

[Chorus]
Liberty to the captives
Opening of the prison to those who are bound
Proclaim the year of the Lord's favor
Comfort all who mourn

[Verse]
To give them a crown of beauty instead of ashes
The oil of gladness instead of mourning
A garment of praise instead of a faint spirit
Oaks of righteousness, the planting of the Lord

[Chorus]
Liberty to the captives
Opening of the prison to those who are bound
Proclaim the year of the Lord's favor
Comfort all who mourn
